name: penguin
description: Insufficient premises on a fresh model: from 'All birds can fly' and 'Tweety is a penguin' the goal 'Tweety can fly' does not follow. Claude asks whether 'All birds' is universal (answered: every bird), formalises, freezes, suggests the missing premise 'Every penguin is a bird' with a proof that it closes the gap and finishes not proved; the person adopts it ('I hold this'); round 2 proves the goal with it.
subject: Demo

expect.ghostStatement: ∀ x : Creature, Penguin x → Bird x

questions.question: Does "All birds can fly" mean every single bird, without exception, or birds typically?

options.label: Every bird, without exception
options.consequence: Any bird at all can fly; the rule applies to Tweety as soon as Tweety is a bird.
options.formalPreview: ∀ x : Creature, Bird x → CanFly x

options.label: Birds typically
options.consequence: Exceptions are allowed, so the rule alone never settles whether a particular bird can fly.

steps.newString:
namespace Demo

/-- creatures -/
axiom Creature : Type
/-- there is at least one creature -/
axiom Creature.exists : Nonempty Creature
instance : Nonempty Creature := Creature.exists
/-- is a bird -/
axiom Bird : Creature → Prop
/-- is a penguin -/
axiom Penguin : Creature → Prop
/-- can fly -/
axiom CanFly : Creature → Prop
/-- Tweety -/
noncomputable opaque tweety : Creature

end Demo

steps.oldString:
natural_name: All birds can fly
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: All birds can fly
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- All birds can fly -/
abbrev all_birds_can_fly : Prop := ∀ x : Creature, Bird x → CanFly x
axiom all_birds_can_fly.holds : all_birds_can_fly

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Tweety is a penguin
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Tweety is a penguin
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Tweety is a penguin -/
abbrev tweety_is_a_penguin : Prop := Penguin tweety
axiom tweety_is_a_penguin.holds : tweety_is_a_penguin

steps.oldString:
natural_name: Tweety can fly
premises: all-birds-can-fly, tweety-is-a-penguin
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
steps.newString:
natural_name: Tweety can fly
premises: all-birds-can-fly, tweety-is-a-penguin
asserted: 2026-11-10
-/
/-- Tweety can fly -/
abbrev tweety_can_fly : Prop := CanFly tweety

args.lean_statement: ∀ x : Creature, Penguin x → Bird x
args.why_needed: Nothing says that a penguin is a bird, so the rule about birds says nothing about Tweety.
args.proof: fun h => all_birds_can_fly.holds tweety (h tweety tweety_is_a_penguin.holds)

args.summary: The goal does not follow: nothing links penguins to birds.
args.gap: Nothing says that a penguin is a bird.

steps.newString:
abbrev tweety_can_fly : Prop := CanFly tweety
theorem tweety_can_fly.holds : tweety_can_fly :=
  all_birds_can_fly.holds tweety (every_penguin_is_a_bird.holds tweety tweety_is_a_penguin.holds)
